# AWS S3 Static Website Hosting

## Project Overview
Deployed a static website using Amazon S3.

## Technologies Used
- AWS S3
- HTML5
- CSS3

## Live Website
https://aws-s3-staticc-website.s3-website.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com

## Project Files
- index.html
- style.css
- screenshots/website.png

## Deployment Steps
1. Created an S3 bucket.
2. Uploaded HTML and CSS files.
3. Enabled static website hosting.
4. Configured public access.
5. Added bucket policy.
6. Verified the live website.
